title: Eagle Paragliding School

services.name: Fly tandem
services.desc: Launch from our local mountain or coastal ridge sites with a certified USHPA Tandem Instructor. Flights offer spectacular views of the Santa Ynez range, Pacific Ocean, and Channel Islands. Mountain flights land in the Santa Barbara foothills - with beach landings possible in late fall, winter, and spring when weather cooperates. Available to anyone 14 or older, under 260 lbs. We use a larger canopy designed to carry two people. Each person has their own harness and the passenger and instructor are connected with spreader bars - instructor in the back, passenger in front. We organize equipment and run a simulation before the actual launch. The instructor double checks your buckles, clips you
